detail.longDescription: Congratulations! You Forgot the Only Important Part. An airport with no passengers wins awards. A presentation has perfect animations but forgets the key slide. An AI-written article accidentally publishes its ChatGPT conversation. The Ministry investigates humanity's remarkable talent for forgetting the only thing that mattered. https:// satiregpt.wordpress.com/2026/0 9/02/congratulations-you-forgot-the-only-important-part/
